prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: a tropical island beach at night. Back (top 42%): starry sky, calm sea glowing with cyan bioluminescent plankton along the waves, a ghostly old ship silhouette far out with pale blue will-o-wisp lights, palm silhouettes. Ground (lower 58%): pale sand with shells, coral pieces and tide pools at the sides. Light: moonlight and cyan sea glow. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a wide 16:9 background ONLY for a side-on JRPG battle, with no characters or UI. Rich, crisp, high-resolution 2D PIXEL ART. Tropical island beach in an endless nighttime world where the sun has vanished. Composition: back/top approximately 42% contains a dark violet star-filled night sky, a calm ocean, thin cyan bioluminescent wave crests, a distant ghostly antique sailing ship silhouette with tiny pale blue will-o'-wisp lights far out at sea, and palm tree silhouettes framing the sides. Lower approximately 58% is a pale sandy walkable ground plane receding at a shallow 3/4 perspective from bottom edge up to the low horizon. Critical gameplay staging: middle of ground from 55% to 90% of picture height, especially centre and right, must stay open, fairly level, unobstructed, and lightly textured for combatants to be overlaid. Group shells, coral fragments, rocks, seaside plants, and little reflective tide pools only on outer sides and distant background. Light from cool moonlight and cyan water glow, without showing a prominent moon. Hue-shifted pixel color ramps: shadows toward violet, highlights toward muted warm yellow. Distinct readable handcrafted pixel clusters, hard square pixels, zero antialiasing, NO soft gradients, NO painterly effects, NO blur. Pixel scale consistently coarse, each intentional art pixel rendered as a sharp 4x4 block in final output. No lanterns, no fire in middle, no people, no creatures, no monsters, no letters, no text, no interface.
